question.problem:
Complete the missing values in the truth table below.

| $x_1$ | $x_2$ | $x_1 \downarrow x_2$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $0$ | $0$ | $\bbox[3pt,border:solid 1pt]{\phantom{\textrm{odd}}}$ |
| $0$ | $1$ | $\bbox[3pt,border:solid 1pt]{\phantom{\textrm{odd}}}$ |
| $1$ | $0$ | $\bbox[3pt,border:solid 1pt]{\phantom{\textrm{odd}}}$ |
| $1$ | $1$ | $\bbox[3pt,border:solid 1pt]{\phantom{\textrm{odd}}}$ |
question.worked_solution:
Recall that $\textrm{True}=1$ and $\textrm{False}=0.$ 

Also, the Peirce arrow $x_1 \downarrow x_2$ is true if and only if both $x_1$ and $x_2$ are false ($0$).

Therefore, the corresponding Boolean function is the following: 

| $x_1$ | $x_2$ | $x_1 \downarrow x_2$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $0$ | $0$ | $\bbox[3pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}1}$ |
| $0$ | $1$ | $\bbox[3pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}0}$ |
| $1$ | $0$ | $\bbox[3pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}0}$ |
| $1$ | $1$ | $\bbox[3pt,Gainsboro]{\color{blue}0}$ |
